items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. No new queue work, requeues, deployments, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, spending, or monetization changes are technically supportable this cycle. Continue only existing failure repair-or-close, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, period-aligned attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. Preserve private launch gates and external outreach status. Retain the three SEO/performance opportunities as deferred backlog only; do not claim revenue, ROI, causal lift, security clearance, or operational readiness.

Existing implementation work may become queue-eligible only after ownership, root cause, deduplication, smallest isolated repair, deterministic validation, rollback evidence, and explicit requeue-or-close disposition are recorded. Existing telemetry may be used as recorded; do not request duplicate telemetry or invent outcomes.

Continue existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate commission as unattributed and retain unknown revenue attribution, margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift. Do not treat traffic, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, performance scores, ordered items, or AI usage as financial returns.

Maintain private launch gates and keep external outreach unsent. Continue the existing consolidated rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work. Public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, credential or permission changes, configuration changes, dependency additions, and security-sensitive releases remain blocked pending required evidence, counsel review, and owner authorization.
